images.name: baaaa
images.alt: Two sheep in a green field; the little one in front has cartoon Gravel God's head.
images.note: His head and collar sit on the lamb's body; the grass behind where the old hat was is patched and slightly soft.

images.name: your-frame-is-all-there-is
images.alt: A gilded picture frame floating in a starry grey galaxy holds cartoon Gravel God's head.
images.note: The inside of the frame is a flat dark panel: the old hat filled most of it and the galaxy behind could not be rebuilt cleanly.
